name: @civio/butterbot
description: Minimal Slack agent harness built on the pi AI libraries.

scripts.start: . ./.env && docker start ${BUTTERBOT_SANDBOX_CONTAINER:?set it in .env} && node src/main.js --sandbox=docker:$BUTTERBOT_SANDBOX_CONTAINER ${BUTTERBOT_PROVIDER:+--provider=$BUTTERBOT_PROVIDER} ${BUTTERBOT_BASE_URL:+--base-url=$BUTTERBOT_BASE_URL} --model="${BUTTERBOT_MODEL:?set it in .env}" "${BUTTERBOT_WORKSPACE:?set it in .env}"
scripts.start:host: . ./.env && node src/main.js --sandbox=host ${BUTTERBOT_PROVIDER:+--provider=$BUTTERBOT_PROVIDER} ${BUTTERBOT_BASE_URL:+--base-url=$BUTTERBOT_BASE_URL} --model="${BUTTERBOT_MODEL:?set it in .env}" "${BUTTERBOT_WORKSPACE:?set it in .env}"
